dataset: Buildings of local importance / Local List gateway
evidence_slice: Exeter City Council's official Buildings of local importance page states that the adopted Exeter Local Plan First Review identifies non-designated heritage assets of local importance, and describes selection criteria including architectural or historic interest, landmark prominence, association with distinctive local activities, and exemplars of distinctive or special building types and styles. It points users to the Local List in Schedule 5, pages 100-106. The selected public HTML window contains no record-level polygon coordinates or downloadable individual-building geometry.

field_evidence.footprint: No record-level polygon coordinates or downloadable individual-building geometry are exposed in the selected public HTML window.
field_evidence.type_use: The official council page explicitly states that Local List selection includes exemplars of distinctive and/or special building types and styles, but it does not bind those criteria to an individual geometry-bearing record in this window.
field_evidence.heritage: The official council page identifies the Local List as non-designated heritage assets of local importance under the adopted Exeter Local Plan First Review.
